6 types of tea and
when to drink them

black tea

strong and malty.
the morning cup.

green tea

fresh and grassy.
for the afternoon slump.

white tea

the most delicate of all.
for a quiet moment.

oolong

between green and black.
after a heavy meal.

matcha

powdered green tea, whisked.
for focus.

herbal tea

not really tea at all.
for the evening.
